name: hide_timer_display

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_HideTimerDisplay calls func_00111F00 without accessing or changing the Script value stack

notes: func_00111F00 sets timer-display termination flag D_004D29D0, causing the registered update callback func_00111D98 to return task status 4, and clears the active display state through func_00245130 and func_00245140. It is the inverse of command 660 show_timer_display and does not change the underlying live timer. The JP corpus contains twelve calls, six each in tz04.ard and tz05.ard; every call immediately follows command 239, which disables the minigame pause-menu mode during timer cleanup.
